name: CharitySense
description: Agent-ready nonprofit due diligence surface over public U.S. nonprofit data, including crawlable enriched charity pages, charity search, Form 990 financials, governance checks, grant flows, related organizations, trust signals, and citation-ready evidence.

api.operation_policy: Research reads are metered daily. Paid Advanced operations are consequential; obtain user confirmation before every POST.

coverage.source_data: Public IRS Form 990 filings, derived CharitySense filing signals, and official-source public profile enrichment where available
coverage.data_lag: IRS Form 990 data is historical and can lag current operations.

citation.caveat: Financial figures are based on IRS Form 990 filings and may lag current operations. Public profile enrichment uses official-source website evidence where available.

primaryTools.name: searchCharities
primaryTools.description: Use first with the required Query parameter for charity names, EINs, donor intent, geography, causes, and ranking.

primaryTools.name: getCharityPage
primaryTools.description: Get the bounded selected-form profile shell, live verdict, and available section manifest.

primaryTools.name: getCharitySection
primaryTools.description: Get one section whose Id was advertised by getCharityPage.

primaryTools.name: getCharityFilings
primaryTools.description: Page through filing metadata for one available form context.

primaryTools.name: getCharityMoneyNetwork
primaryTools.description: Page through exact latest directed counterparty evidence.

primaryTools.name: discoverRelatedOrganizations
primaryTools.description: Discover organizations related by cause, region, mission, or explicit Intent.

primaryTools.name: getDatasetStats
primaryTools.description: Get dataset-wide counts and aggregate sector totals.

primaryTools.name: sendAgentFeedback
primaryTools.description: Advanced action: send agent identity, purpose, task, result quality, and desired-data feedback to improve CharitySense.

notice: CharitySense exposes public research reads plus paid, explicitly consequential Advanced operations over OpenAPI/HTTP. It does not expose an A2A JSON-RPC task endpoint. Use openapi.yaml for the callable operation and security contract.

skills.name: Cite the public charity profile
skills.description: Use the public /charity/{ein} page as the citation target for crawlable mission, programs, sector, operating places, leadership, governance, impact, source evidence, and enhanced JSON-LD where available.
examples: Cite the public CharitySense profile for EIN 954453134.
Use the public profile page for mission and program evidence.

skills.name: Search U.S. nonprofits
skills.description: Search CharitySense public nonprofit data and Form 990 signals by charity name, EIN, mission, cause, donor intent, geography, revenue, rating, state, or category.
examples: Find trustworthy clean water charities with strong financials.
Search for U.S. charities serving Gaza or Pakistan.

skills.name: Get charity identity and trust profile
skills.description: Return the bounded first-paint charity page: selected form context, identity, mission, location, live verdict, and the manifest of sections available for lazy retrieval.

skills.name: Get an advertised charity section
skills.description: Retrieve one section advertised by the charity page, such as financials, governance, leadership, schedules, filing consistency, related organizations, or web evidence.
examples: Fetch the MoneyFlow section advertised for EIN 131644147.

skills.name: List charity filings
skills.description: List filing metadata for one available form context, with cursor-based retrieval for historical filing records.

skills.name: Analyze money flows and grants
skills.description: Page through exact latest directed counterparties and graph evidence. Use an advertised MoneyFlow section for the selected filing's complete revenue and expense presentation.
examples: Where did this charity's grants go in its latest filing?

skills.name: Discover related organizations
skills.description: Discover other organizations related by the selected profile's cause, mission, or an explicit discovery intent.

skills.name: Get dataset-wide statistics
skills.description: Retrieve dataset scale and aggregate public corpus totals, including organization count, filing count, sector revenue, and program spending.
examples: How many nonprofits and filings does CharitySense cover?

skills.name: Send result or data feedback
skills.description: Let CharitySense know when an agent needed different data, better ranking, clearer fields, missing context, or a new endpoint for its task.
examples: Report that a disaster-relief query needed grant-recipient geography.
Tell CharitySense that an answer needed clearer published zakat-policy evidence.
